oot_writer.Rom: md5 of the big-endian ROM -> version; else dmadata signature (entry 0 = {0,0x1060,0,0}, entry 2 points at itself) + PAL region byte. n64_rom.normalize fixes v64/n64 order by magic (the Rev B zip holds a .n64-named v64 member).

## File layout

| container | format | reader | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ROM dmadata (DMA table)` | {vromStart, vromEnd, romStart, romEnd} per file at 0x7430 (1.0/1.1), 0x7960 (1.2), 0x7950 (PAL), 0x7170 (GC); romEnd 0 = stored raw | gbox/oot_writer.py (Rom) | DmaMgr searches the table linearly, so changed files go raw past the ROM end |
| `Yaz0 files` | every retail file Yaz0-compressed; decoded on demand | gbox/formats/lz.py yaz0_decompress via oot_writer.Rom.file |  |
| `code (DMA 27, PAL/GC-EU 28)` | holds gObjectTable (object id -> VROM range, found by its gameplay_keep entry), gActorOverlayTable (0x20-byte entries, found by fit), Link's 20 hand/waist/first-person DL tables (z_player_lib.c, found by content) | gbox/oot_writer.py, gbox/oot_swap.py (_code_positions, actor_table) | code must keep its size |
| `object files (segment 6)` | SkeletonHeader / FlexSkeletonHeader (Standard/LOD/Skin limbs), F3DEX2 display lists, Vtx, CI4/CI8/RGBA16/IA/I textures | gbox/oot_writer.py (skeleton, run_dl, object_mesh, write_gltf), gbox/oot_inventory.py, gbox/oot_cast.py (102 skeletal objects scanned) | object_link_boy 0x14 skel 0x377F4, object_link_child 0x15 skel 0x2CF6C, gameplay_keep 0x01 |
| `scene / room files (segment 3)` | gSceneTable, scene + room headers, object lists, RoomShape mesh entries | gbox/oot_cast.py (contexts, growth_plan), gbox/oot_place.py | object space ~1000 KB per scene (1050/1150 KB in boss rooms) |

## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** oot_hot_swap: a single NPC object rewritten in its loaded slot (paused, expected bytes checked, rollback); visual in-game check pending. Link and ROM mods need a relaunch; keep_state swaps carry stale dmadata, so load the file.

**Pick whip: partial.** pick_identify backend 'oot': actor nearest the point via viewProjectionMtxF + its object segment + SkelAnime; replaceable.live only for NTSC 1.2 non-Link NPCs -> pick_replace calls characters op=live_use; Link -> build mode

**Live controls:** oot_models tool ops where\|pick\|actors\|skeleton\|floor_point\|apply\|clear\|status\|replace_object; characters op=live_use (oot_hot_swap); zelda / zelda_oot (give, kit, goto, skip_deku_tree, scale_link, scale_sword); no OoT codes file in profiles/gamedata

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- oot_hot_swap never shown working in game: a private cloned-save test stalled on a black frame with object DMA pending (docs/model_swaps.md #706)
- No live writer for Link (player slot always goes to build + relaunch)
- Live swap is NTSC 1.2 only (1aa2e4bb5797493f); 446e8e442d726e31 (1.0, the cast ROM in oot_cast.md) and the GC MQ ROM get build mode; gc-eu-mq has no entry in oot.LAYOUTS so no live RAM tools at all
- Compound-object NPCs (Kokiri girls + Fado, En_Hy townsfolk) are refused live
- Hot swap uses the older npc_reclaim, which oot_cast.md says misses lui/addiu code references that npc_regions catches
- A hot swap ends at the next object reload; unlike statues there is no watcher that re-applies it
- Cast builds (survey: roulette cs1 builds) are verified_in_game false; the oot_cast live check was not run
